why_no_new_terms: A narrative text, research like documents 22–25 and 29: its defined things are the chapters' own labels, system designators (K-1123, Omikron-9, KDSI-Gamma-7) and borrowed concepts (IFS, Autopoiesis, Heldinnenreise). A page created from them would say nothing a reading does not; the Guardian and world names it gives go on guardians and kern-welten by the sentence (J116).
